name: Do I really need dozens of AI bots to build multiple income streams?
description: No. Multiple bots are optional workflow components, not automatic income streams. Start with one assistant and one measurable business outcome, then add another

mainEntity.name: Do I really need dozens of AI bots to build multiple income streams?

acceptedAnswer.text: More bots do not automatically create more income; they create more possible workflows that still need a customer, offer, platform, and owner. Run My AI Biz’s 38-bot resource is described as a library of adaptable blueprints, not 38 identical software products or proven businesses. Key factors are whether each assistant has a distinct responsibility, whether inputs are accurate, and whether the handoffs can be checked. Start with one assistant and a single measurable outcome, such as a weekly research brief or draft sales sequence. Add another only when the first process is stable and the next assistant removes a clear bottleneck. Keep separate records for each project so audiences, offers, and claims do not get mixed.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Multiple bots are optional workflow components, not automatic income streams. Start with one assistant and one measurable business outcome, then add another only when it solves a clear bottleneck and its inputs, outputs, and approval points are easy to check.
